name: Piq 'n' Mix in: Meat-Cute Aboard the Bunnycular
source:
A yuri visual novel about two women in the wrong place the right time. One a starving hunter, the other her unwitting victim, trapped together on board a lonely funicular ride. Will the vampire be able to stop herself from ravaging this stranger? Will the prey realise what's going on before it's too late? Won't it be exciting to watch the spectacle unfold?

[From [url=https://unloveablehands.itch.io/pnm-bunnycular]itch.io[/url]]
